items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 'Equipment' (collective/plural concept, list of 24 machines); only 'Add equipment' uses the filled primary style (bg-blue-700), while 'Export' and 'Import' use the secondary outlined style; audit confirms headerPrimaryActions: 1.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: No KPI card row exists; filter bar has #searchInput, #locationFilter, #statusFilter (2 dropdown filters) plus a 'More filters' button; audit reports firstTableTop: 233 (within 900px viewport) and the screenshot shows the table fully visible above the fold.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: sortRows() sorts by daysUntil(nextInspection) ascending with nulls (retired, no date) last; screenshot confirms the two 'Overdue' rows (EQ-1004, EQ-1012) appear first, followed by 'Due soon' rows, then undbadged rows.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: inspectionBadge() renders 'Overdue' for diff<0 and 'Due soon' for diff<=14, visible as text badges next to the Next inspection date in the screenshot.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: formatDate() uses toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {day:'2-digit', month:'2-digit', year:'numeric'}) for all rows (e.g. '03/11/2026'); every row shows an ID like 'EQ-1004' under the machine name.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: Tabs read 'All 24', 'Operational 16', 'In maintenance 4', 'Down 2', 'Retired 2'; summary line '24 machines' below the filter bar.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence:
Every row stacks the equipment name and ID on two lines inside the Machine cell (e.g. 'CNC Stamping Press #1
EQ-1001
'); audit confirms rows.double: 24, rows.single: 0 and flags rule 'table-row-two-line' (24 of 24 rows multi-line). Row actions are a single icon button with aria-label='Actions for ...' (acceptable count/accessibility), but the single-line requirement fails.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: A no-results state exists ('No machines match these filters.' with #clearFiltersBtn 'Clear filters') distinct from the first-use empty state ('No equipment yet. Add your first machine...'), but there is no loading state (table renders synchronously from a hardcoded array, no skeleton/spinner) and no error state with retry anywhere in the script.

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Audit reports smallTargets: 0 and contrast checked: 228 / unknown: 0 with no font-size or contrast violations listed beyond the unrelated 16px body-text note.

notes: No template tells observed: header has no greeting, no KPI tiles, no gradients/glass, no uppercase tracked labels, no emoji icons (the row action uses a plain unicode ellipsis character with a proper aria-label), status badges use a restrained 4-colour palette (green/blue/red/slate) plus amber/red for due-soon/overdue rather than an arbitrary rainbow, and radii (4-6px) are standard. Main defects: table rows are two-line (name + ID stacked) rather than single-line, and there is no loading or error/retry state implemented.
